scope: Four complete #18 benchmark stones; 17-frame core primary, 33-frame window sensitivity only.

primary_definition.units: activation-trace units per observed source step

redundancy.interpretation: Local mobility is related to interval excursion but materially more distinct from thresholded spatial switching; whole-stone mobility is redundant with whole-stone excursion in this four-stone core.

decisions.reason: Core-to-wide rank rho=1.0; pair evidence corresponds to visible regional change; pooled local mobility is not identical to either #26 excursion or #28 switching.
Core-to-wide rank rho=0.8; LG756520111 inner supplies a strong excursion-vs-typical-motion disagreement while pair evidence remains visually ordered.
Core-to-wide rank rho=1.0 and switching-rank correlation is only 0.6 within this band, preserving a continuous-change interpretation distinct from threshold switching.
Four-stone core ranking is identical to whole-stone activation total excursion (rho=1.0), so a second broad scalar is not justified.
Pooled core local Q90 and median ranks are highly similar (rho≈0.94); Q90 does not justify a separate primary scalar.
Issue #26 retained regional raw activation as an audit primitive and relative activation as the primary local descriptor; #30 does not promote the raw branch into a second mobility family.
Inherits #26 outer-region pose/persistent-support sensitivity; #30 cannot upgrade an unresolved upstream trace.
Inherits #26 semantic correspondence/support uncertainty; useful for falsification but not a primary descriptor.

evidence.purpose: high continuous mobility versus relatively low switching
low continuous mobility versus high switching
strong visible mobility event plus near-static control

constraints: No brightness, mask, support or normalization is independently rederived from images.
Missing/rejected/non-finite activation observations break adjacency; no interpolation.
No sparkle frequency in time or degrees is inferred.
No quality grade, fire, leakage or calibrated light-return claim is made.
Validity is inherited monotonically from the exact #26 source trace.
